name: Poppler
description: Text, page images, embedded images and document information from PDF pages, with the Poppler PDF tools. (Imported PDFs are split into pages by PyPDF.)

pdf2text.name: Extract text from PDF
pdf2text.description: The text layer of the page as a .txt file. Digital PDFs only: scanned pages have no text layer (render them as images and use OCR).
pdf2text.info: Text extracted from input PDF file

pdf2images.name: Render PDF as images
pdf2images.description: The page as a PNG image, as it looks on screen; the input for OCR and image crunchers.

resolution.name: Resolution (dpi)
resolution.help: Dots per inch of the image, 72-600. Use 300 for OCR of small print.

pdf2images.info: Rendered image from input PDF file

pdfimages.name: Extract images from PDF
pdfimages.description: The images embedded in the page, each at its original resolution, as PNG files. A page can have none or many.
pdfimages.info: Embedded images extracted from input PDF file

pdfinfo.name: PDF info
pdfinfo.description: Document information as a text file: title, author, creator, creation and change dates, page size, PDF version and more.

thumbnail.name: Create PDF thumbnails
thumbnail.description: Create preview.jpg and thumbnail.jpg for a PDF file.
thumbnail.info: Creates preview and thumbnail images for first page
